result.summary: Found several layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names and delivery info, overlapping text on a card, and cut-off category chips and list items.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on tap; ensure cards have enough width or horizontal scroll shows full titles.

issues.description: Delivery time text on Tokumaru Ramen Bar is garbled/overlapping as '25-3Ddelivery' instead of a clear '25-35 min delivery'.
issues.suggestion: Fix text layout so time range and 'delivery' don't collide; ensure proper spacing and no overflow on the card meta row.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza) is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar, hiding title and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content so the last card is fully visible above the tab bar.

issues.description: Category filter chips row is cut off on the right (partial chip visible after Healthy).
issues.suggestion: Indicate horizontal scroll more clearly or ensure chips fit/wrap without clipping the edge awkwardly.

issues.description: Third card in Fastest near you shows incomplete name and may confuse users about the restaurant identity.
issues.suggestion: Show full restaurant name or a clear truncated form with accessibility label for the full name.
